## Accepted execution contract v2 — 2026-10-07

#5091 decision packet is merged in #5100 at44a72f3856cac51afdb09e60c5394706f261e930 (reviewed supporting head e1e0b63ac998806c12f42943ddc8b8d91056dc81). Accepted target/admission/ownership contract: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6034625243 and its recorded corrections. Production runtime baseline797d783b remains identical across that tests/docs merge.

Required measurement prerequisite #5101 lands actual source-byte binding, explicit read counts and compatible bounded public GC/ACK samplers before new qualifying #5092/#5095 captures and full #5096. The next matched read protocol is1000 complete-read calls,50 mutation calls, batch32 and4096/16384 populations; targets and both noise rules remain fixed. Earlier failed/noisy/unlanded-overlay blocks remain diagnostic. Runtime predecessor and final qualification gates remain mandatory; no runtime or parent performance acceptance yet.

## Goal

Add a source-aware native field-update path for an existing atomic collection request, so changing bio/email/city does not reconstruct/decode/re-encode every old full document or rewrite unchanged typed fields. Primary deliverable: **PR** after accepted [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) and merged [#5092](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5092) shared point-row resolver. Keep generic callback UpdateBatch as the general complete-document fallback.

## Current path and reuse

[UpdateBatch planning](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a/TreeDB/collections/api.go#L19224) reconstructs old complete rows before invoking a callback, then projects the replacement and derives index state. The ordinary-manifest reconstruction lookup can scan physical rows. The historical C callback merely returns a predetermined pre-encoded replacement; it does not decode current JSON. Native replacement already avoids the old-row reconstruction, so first measure/adopt that existing path for equivalent replacement requests, then qualify field edits as a distinct explicit public contract. `ReplaceTypedBatch` already shares this planner and derives admitted strings directly, but represents full replacement. [UpdateTypedMetadataByID](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a/TreeDB/collections/typed_metadata.go#L296) already has a narrowly restricted meta.* contract and preserved-coordinate representation. Reuse these mechanisms, current-row lookup, unique final-owner checks and existing atomic root publisher.

#1186 owns the broader internal/public collection transaction roadmap. This issue owns source-aware lowering of **one existing atomic operation/batch**, not a multi-operation staged/coalesced unit of work, public transaction API or independent consistency model. Record the reused #1186 seam; keep its remaining transaction obligations there.

## Recommended architecture

Represent admitted field edits as an owned typed mutation input plus a source-bound plan: captured row identity/generation, changed fields, preserved physical coordinates, explicit residual action, old/new indexed values, deterministic final result/no-op state and existing publish inputs. Revalidate old state/schema/conflicts at the authoritative commit boundary. Unchanged native columns retain their valid references; changed fields use existing native asset output and reachability accounting. Route read lookup through [#5092](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5092) instead of another full-row scanner.

Begin with the R1 non-null declared string columns and explicit residual JSON replacement/patch semantics chosen by [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091). Presence, null, delete/missing and unchanged residual behavior must be distinct. Do not implicitly broaden meta.* restrictions or claim numeric/nullable/vector support beyond admitted carriers. Unsupported generic callback behavior keeps its existing complete-row route.

Canonical replay must deterministically reproduce the atomic edit. Reuse existing command kinds/lowering where sound; if a new typed patch command/layout is necessary, [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) must select it with bounded validation, recorded old-state/conflict semantics and profile support. Callbacks are never replayed, a private sidecar is never commit authority, and partial patch acknowledgement cannot bypass exact asset/WAL closure.

## Test-first and exit gates

Start with public differential tests against equivalent generic complete-row updates for changed/nonchanged bio/email/city, preserved residual fields, no-op/missing counts, unique value swaps and conflicts, repeated IDs, source replacement, held old/current views, caller-input mutation and release. Add a failing work invariant: selected native edits perform zero old full-document reconstruction and preserve unchanged typed-field coordinates/bytes. Test concurrent conflicting state/schema, process cuts, replay/reopen and maintenance over both durable roots.

Report full generic versus native request cost for equivalent final rows/indexes and durability; setup/preparation and ACK phases separated but all charged. Sweep one/32 rows, narrow/wide bio, no-index/email+city, indexed/nonindexed edits. Count full-row reconstructions, decoded/emitted fields, changed/preserved asset bytes, index probes/deltas, WAL command bytes/syncs, allocation and owned/peak memory. New API incremental costs are measured separately; no less-work comparator is used to claim equivalent complete-read speed.

- [ ] Public native field-edit contract selected and documented, with explicit support/fallback.
- [ ] Old full-document round trip eliminated and unchanged fields preserved on selected path.
- [ ] Index/current/held-view/ownership/recovery parity and one-operation atomicity pass.
- [ ] [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) native processing/allocation objective passes; complete durable latency and unavoidable I/O are honestly reported.
- [ ] No duplicate transaction planner/asset format/authority; existing generic/source paths protected.

Edit map: `api.go` direct update lowering, `typed_batch.go`, `typed_metadata.go` preservation, `typed_source.go`, `column_publish_write.go`, and existing command encoder/executor only as selected. Update `r1-indexed-mutations.md`, `collections-write-domain.md`, `typed-row-store.md`, API examples/verification and command support/recovery/storage specs for any selected new command or representation.


## Shared execution contract

Parent: [#5090](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5090). Planning base: `b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a`; recheck affected production paths and owners before implementation. Read the parent's semantic, performance, documentation and reassessment contract.

This is a **performance-objective** packet. Prove the real public caller → eligibility → optimized primitive → fallback, with path/work counters; helper-only timings are insufficient. First capture the named invariant failing for the intended reason, or record a justified characterization exception for a behavior-preserving refactor. Run affected races, recovery/reopen and fault tests. Compare identical before/after commands and equivalent returned data, visibility, ownership and durable ACKs; report latency/throughput, B/op, allocs/op, setup/first-use, retained/peak memory and relevant storage/I/O/work counters. Charge allocations by row/request/batch/setup, and account for backing capacity and pins. Minimize avoidable copies/temporary representations before completion.

[#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) freezes the workload, numeric objective/budgets and noise policy **before candidate measurements**, from phase-attributed baselines. A pass requires the structural gate below and a repeatable material improvement beyond that policy; no-regression alone does not pass. If improvement is insufficient, profile and revise this packet or map a blocking replacement before final qualification. Unexplained material regressions block; an accepted necessary residual needs evidence, alternatives and explicit acceptance.

Use an isolated topic branch and PR; preserve unrelated work. Current repository policy requires a PR and strict current-head `TreeDB required gate`; the required formal-approval count is zero. Refresh rules before merge. Request credit-consuming AI review only for mature code/tests/performance evidence/docs, resolve findings, and repeat only for changed evidence. No execution or merge is performed by publishing these issues.



## Accepted M representation/API amendment

Root selected flattened CRL3 schema-ordinal direct field sources, TCPA v10 sparse owned changed slots, and native PatchTypedStringsBatch with explicit residual Preserve/Replace. Unchanged retained JSON preserves its existing persistent ValuePtr by omitting primary delta. No insert conversion, residual duplicate store, history chain, sourceV2 adoption, hidden generic fallback, or target waiver. Canonical command/replay, metadata coexistence, bounded owned scatter reads, before-timing numeric admission freeze, and complete current/index/held/reopen/maintenance proofs are mandatory. Full decision: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6036479893

Implementation may proceed provisionally on frozen corrected R; merged #5092 remains a merge prerequisite. Review/land measurement instrumentation before expensive qualification; #5101 covers R/L prerequisites only.

## Narrow owned B1 preparation decision

https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6037373098 selects a composite pre-WAL immutable leaf-image owner, request-local clean workspace and individually owned output pages. Both authoritative preparation and Apply consume it. General B>1/ranges/maintenance tuning/global pooling rewrite are excluded. Existing deletion guards stay unchanged until complete actual numeric backing and authority/replay proof is accepted. All preflight work, backing and old/new overlap remain charged; no performance acceptance.


## Constructor prerequisite selected — 2026-10-08, 08:28 UTC

Required final acceptance/merge prerequisite: [#5113](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5113), the same-Pager constructor resident account, complete shared loans, pre-WAL capacity envelope and joined teardown. The historical Pager is born before the former first-request master, so attaching a request factory cannot certify its backing. Component construction can continue provisionally; full finite/native admission and this node's final runtime acceptance require #5113 accepted and merged with actual producer/retained-lifetime census and unchanged whole128MiB fit. No larger cap, default change, first-request reattribution, second budget/registry or external unfrozen ABI.
title: [R1 architecture] Plan typed field updates from source rows and preserve unchanged assets
